title: Page 9
lines: 见状，邵清凡双眸一沉，本想出声喝止，却在瞥见她脸上的娇羞时蓦地止住未出口的话，神情复杂的看着他们。
「你们……当真和好了？」他哑声问。
绦岚秋脸儿一红，有些羞涩的点头。「嗯。」
她的回答像一盆冷水，让邵清凡浑身一冷，就连那颗满心期待见到她的心也为之冰冷。「这是……真的？」
他大受打击的模样让绦岚秋感到十分歉疚，低声说：「邵公子，我曾和你说过，你我之间的缘分无法强求，谢谢你这阵子的帮忙，但除了谢谢，我无法再多给你什么，希望你能体谅。」
他一番爱恋，换来的竟是体谅二字？
邵清凡忍不住苦笑，表情十分落寞沉痛。他本以为他的等待能换得她的感情，没想到……
罢了，他早知道绦岚秋心里一直只有封竞天，就算他再怎么等待，她也不会回头看他一眼，既然她终于得到属于她的幸福，那么，他何不大方的祝福她？
想通了、看开了，即使心仍隐隐发疼，他仍是挤出一抹笑，「他若是敢再欺侮你，随时可以来找我，我永远都是你的……朋友。」
闻言，绦岚秋红了眼眶，哽声说：「谢谢你……」
她何德何能，能让像他这般伟岸优秀的男子这么爱着？可惜今生她的心已容不下第二人，对他，除了抱歉，还是抱歉。
相较于他们之间的温情，封竞天可是老大不高兴，送走邵清凡后，马上醋劲大发的吻住她的唇，直到她无法喘息，才甘心放手。
偎在他怀中，绦岚秋俏脸通红，羞赧的轻喊：「这儿是大厅，你怎么能……」
这儿人来人往，若是让人看见，岂不给人笑话？
「谁教你招了朵这么大的桃花，让我抱着醋桶狂饮，若不这么做，我心里的闷气可消不去！」虽然姓邵的家伙不会再来纠缠他的女人，可他临走前那句话却让他不满到了极点。
他居然当着他的面诱拐他的爱妻，还让她受委屈的时候随时能去找他？笑话！他怎么可能会给他机会，他就慢慢等到老死吧！
他这话让绦岚秋心花朵朵开，甜美的娇颜忍不住漾起一抹幸福的笑。
凝视着那抹笑，封竞天双眸一沉，蓦地抱起她便往厅外走去。
她吓了一跳，忙问：「你要带我去哪？」
「房间。」他毫不隐藏对她的欲望。
她脸儿一红，忙挣扎，「不行！爹爹只准我出门两个时辰，现在已过了一个时辰了，更何况我还得去锦绣庄一趟，你快放我下来。」
虽然大多时候都是由竹儿出面帮她打理锦绣庄的事，可是今儿个是月底，她得上锦绣庄核对帐目，因为思念，这才特地绕过来见他，若是真让他给拐上床，别说正事没法做，一个时辰内能不能赶回去都是个问题。
「该死！」闻言，封竞天低咒一声，却不得不停下脚步。
他一停下，绦岚秋马上从他身上溜下。
见她迫不及待想逃离，他可不高兴了，再次将她拉回怀中，像孩子般任性的问：「你说！是锦绣庄重要还是我？」
听见这醋味十足的问话，绦岚秋忍不住噗哧一笑，柔声说：「当然是你。」
在她心中，没有任何人、任何事比他更重要。
俊眸倏地一亮，「那么你就别去了，留下来陪我。」
她却摇摇头，「不成，今儿个是发饷的日子，我不能不去。」
他俊眸沉下，咬牙说：「你就要是封家的主母，根本不需要自己赚钱，那间锦绣庄干脆顶给人，别做了。」
反正他怎么看那邵清凡都不顺眼，锦绣庄的店面便是同他承租，他正好趁这机会，斩断所有能让他们接触的可能。
他打着如意算盘，却忘了他的女人有着执拗的一面。
「这怎么成！」她拧起秀眉，语气虽温柔，却十分坚持，「锦绣庄是我的心血，里头每一样产品都是我亲手缝制、设计而成，那儿的一切，从无到有，全是我一手包办，怎么能说顶人就顶人？」
封竞天抿着唇，不甘的说：「你刚刚明明说了我比较重要。」
绦岚秋忍不住失笑，「这怎么能比？」
「我不管！我要你留下陪我！」他干脆耍赖，将她紧紧抱住。
他连续三日到绦府拜访，都让绦威以一句岚秋没空给赶了出去，若不是他有错在先，他哪肯乖乖走人，现下好不容易见到她，他岂会这么容易放人。
「别这样……」他这摸样非但没让她感到不耐，反而心里泛甜，像哄小孩般哄着。「我去去就回，明儿个我再找机会来见你，好吗？」
「岳父最好有这么容易放人！」他说得咬牙切齿。
「我会想办法，时间快来不及了，我真的得走了。」她语带歉然的说。
她也很想他，可正事要紧，她不得不先去处理。
即便不愿，他也只能乖乖放人，然而不知为何，他突然有种错觉，像是她就要消失在他眼前一样，他焦急地连忙大喊，「岚秋！」
她顿住脚步，不解地回头问道：「怎么了？」
「我和你一同去。」心里的不安让他无法放她独行。
「爷，您不能出去，这个月的帐目，你连看都还没看……」本要去书房、正巧经过厅外的秦穆一听，连忙上前拦人。
封竞天看着他怀中那叠厚厚的帐本，正要开口，却被绦岚秋抢先一步。
「你忙吧！我自个儿去行了。」
为了不耽误彼此，绦岚秋转身便走，脚程之快让封竞天连阻止都来不及，只能眼睁睁看着她离开。
头，好沉……
忍着昏沉睁开双眼，绦岚秋有丝迷蒙的看着顶上俗丽的红帐帘。
这……是哪儿？她怎么会……
正当她不懂明明该去锦绣庄的自己怎么会躺在床上时，胸前突然传来一阵湿润，让她蓦地回神。
当她低头看见有个陌生男人正趴在她胸前时，俏脸倏地一白，吓得她奋力一推，将压在她身上的男人给重重推下床。
「你、你是谁？」发现自己竟**着上身，她花容失色的拉过被褥，将身体紧紧包住，美眸惊惶的看着从地上爬起的男人。
男人站起身，身上满满的酒气，打了个酒嗝，邪气的说：「这才对嘛！像只死鱼似的怎么玩？这样才来劲儿。快来！小美人，让爷抱抱……」
见他扑来，绦岚秋忙往床角缩去，大喊，「你别过来！」
男人又笑了，「不过来，爷要怎么疼你？快，爷忍不住了，快来帮爷消消火……」
说着，他再次朝她扑去。
她被逼得无处可躲，情急之下抽起发上的簪子，指向他，急喊，「不准过来！」
被她用簪子指着鼻头，男人就算再醉也知危险，皱起眉，低骂道：「搞什么鬼！大爷我花钱玩女人，可不是来给你玩的，别闹了，把那玩意扔了，否则等会儿让你好看！」
玩……他究竟在说什么？绦岚秋六神无主，根本搞不清楚状况，紧紧的握住手中的簪子，颤声问：「你、你究竟是谁？这究竟是哪里？我怎么会……怎么会在这？」
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
客栈……买下的女人？
这话让绦岚秋惊惶的脸色更白，忙摇头，「不！我没有卖身，这其中一定有误会，我不能留在这……」
她想起身，却发现身子虚软无力，一股酥麻由腹中急速上扬，让她整个人臊热不已。
「这是什么话！」男人挡在她身前，不悦的说：「爷可是付了大把的银子，好不容易来了个大美人，不当尝怎么成？你不能走！」
content_en:
Upon seeing this, Shao Qingfan's eyes sank, and he wanted to stop shouting, but when he caught a glimpse of the shyness on her face, he suddenly stopped his words and looked at them with a complicated expression.
"You...really reconciled?" he asked hoarsely.
Qi Lanqiu blushed and nodded shyly. "Yeah."
Her answer was like a basin of cold water, chilling Shao Qingfan's whole body, and even his heart, which was full of expectations to see her, became cold. "Is this...really?"
His shocked look made Qi Lanqiu feel very guilty, and whispered: "Master Shao, I once told you that the fate between you and me cannot be forced. Thank you for your help these days, but apart from thank you, I can't give you anything more. I hope you can understand."
After all his love, what he got in exchange was understanding?
Shao Qingfan couldn't help but smile bitterly, his expression was very lonely and sad. He thought that his waiting would win her affection, but he didn't expect...
Forget it, he had known that Qian Lanqiu had always only had Feng Jingtian in his heart. No matter how much he waited, she would never look back at him. Now that she finally got her happiness, why didn't he bless her generously?
After he figured it out and looked away, even though his heart still ached, he still forced a smile and said, "If he dares to bully you again, he can come to me at any time. I will always be your... friend."
Hearing this, Gui Lanqiu's eyes turned red and she choked out, "Thank you..."
How could she be able to make a great and outstanding man like him fall in love so much? It's a pity that her heart can no longer tolerate the second person in this life. To him, besides being sorry, she is still sorry.
Compared to the warmth between them, Feng Jingtian was unhappy. After seeing Shao Qingfan off, he immediately jealously kissed her lips until she couldn't breathe, and then he was willing to let go.
Nestling in his arms, Gui Lanqiu's pretty face flushed, and she shouted shyly: "This is the hall, how could you..."
There are people coming and going here. If someone sees them, wouldn't they make them laugh?
"Who taught you to recruit such a big peach blossom and let me drink wine from a bucket of vinegar? If I didn't do this, I would never be able to get rid of the suffocation in my heart!" Although the guy named Shao would not pester his woman again, what he said before leaving made him extremely dissatisfied.
He actually abducted his beloved wife in front of him and allowed her to go to him at any time when she was wronged? joke! How could he give him a chance? Just wait until he dies of old age!
His words made Guanlan Qiu's heart bloom, and her sweet face couldn't help but smile with happiness.
Staring at that smile, Feng Jingtian's eyes darkened, he suddenly picked her up and walked out of the hall.
She was startled and asked quickly: "Where are you taking me?"
"Room." He made no secret of his desire for her.
She blushed and struggled, "No! Daddy only allowed me to go out for two hours, and it's already been an hour, not to mention I have to go to Jinxiu Manor, please let me down quickly."
Although most of the time it was Zhu'er who helped her take care of things at Jinxiu Manor, but today was the end of the month and she had to go to Jinxiu Manor to check the accounts. Because she missed him, she specially came around to see him. If she really let him go to bed, not to mention that she couldn't do business, it was a question of whether she could get back within an hour.
"Damn!" Hearing this, Feng Jingtian cursed, but had to stop.
As soon as he stopped, Guan Lanqiu immediately slipped off him.
Seeing that she couldn't wait to escape, he was not happy. He pulled her back into his arms again and asked willfully like a child: "Tell me! Is it more important for Splendid Village or me?"
Hearing this jealous question, Gui Lanqiu couldn't help but smile and said softly, "Of course it's you."
In her heart, no one or anything was more important than him.
His handsome eyes suddenly lit up, "Then don't go and stay with me."
But she shook her head, "No, today is a pay day, so I have to go."
His handsome eyes sank, and he gritted his teeth and said, "You are going to be the mistress of the Feng family. You don't need to make money by yourself at all. You might as well give Jinxiu Manor to others instead of doing it."
Anyway, he didn't like Shao Qingfan no matter what. Jinxiuzhuang's store was rented from him, so he took advantage of this opportunity to cut off all possibilities of contact between them.
He made his wishful thinking, but forgot that his woman had a stubborn side.
"How is this possible?" She frowned, her tone gentle but very insistent, "Jinxiu Village is my hard work. Every product in it is sewn and designed by me. Everything there, from scratch, is all done by me. How can I say that I support others?"
Feng Jingtian pursed his lips and said unwillingly, "You just said clearly that I am more important."
Qi Lanqiu couldn't help laughing, "How can this be compared?"
"I don't care! I want you to stay with me!" He simply lied and hugged her tightly.
He visited Sui Mansion for three days in a row, but Sui Wei kicked her out because Lan Qiu was not available. If he hadn't made a mistake first, he wouldn't have been willing to leave. Now that he finally saw her, how could he let her go so easily.
"Don't be like this..." His behavior not only did not make her feel impatient, but instead made her feel sweet, coaxing her like a child. "I'll go and come back. I'll find another chance to see you tomorrow, okay?"
"My father-in-law had better let me go so easily!" he said through gritted teeth.
"I will think of a way. Time is running out. I really have to go." She said apologetically.
She missed him too, but business was important and she had to deal with it first.
Even if he didn't want to, he could only let her go. However, for some reason, he suddenly had the illusion that she was about to disappear before his eyes. He anxiously shouted, "Lan Qiu!"
She paused, turned around in confusion and asked, "What's wrong?"
"I'll go with you." The uneasiness in his heart prevented him from letting her go alone.
"Sir, you can't go out. You haven't even looked at this month's accounts..." Qin Mu, who was going to the study and happened to be passing by the hall, heard this and quickly stepped forward to stop him.
Feng Jingtian looked at the thick stack of ledgers in his arms and was about to speak, but Guan Lanqiu beat him to it.
"You go ahead and get busy! I'll go by myself."
In order not to delay each other, Guan Lanqiu turned around and left. The pace was so fast that Feng Jingtian had no time to stop her and could only watch her leave.
Chapter 10(2)
My head feels so heavy...
Enduring the drowsiness, she opened her eyes and looked vaguely at the gaudy red curtain on the top.
Where...is this? How could she...
Just when she didn't understand why she was lying on the bed when she should be going to Jinxiuzhuang, a sudden feeling of moisture came from her chest, which brought her back to reality.
When she lowered her head and saw a strange man lying on her chest, her pretty face suddenly turned pale. She was so frightened that she pushed hard and pushed the man on top of her out of bed.
"Who are you?" Realizing that her upper body was naked, she pulled the quilt over her face and wrapped her body tightly. Her beautiful eyes looked at the man who got up from the ground in panic.
The man stood up, smelling of alcohol, and burped, and said evilly: "That's right! How can you play like a dead fish? This is how you feel excited. Come on! Little beauty, let me hug you..."
Seeing him rushing towards him, Guan Lanqiu hurriedly shrank to the corner of the bed and shouted, "Don't come over!"
The man laughed again, "But come here, how can I hurt you? Come on, I can't bear it anymore, come and help me calm down..."
With that said, he rushed towards her again.
She was forced to have nowhere to hide. In desperation, she pulled out the hairpin from her hair, pointed it at him, and yelled, "Don't come over!"
When she pointed the hairpin at her nose, the man knew the danger no matter how drunk he was. He frowned and cursed: "What the hell! Master, I spent money to play with women, not for you. Stop making trouble and throw that thing away, otherwise I will make you look good later!"
Play...what on earth is he talking about? Gui Lanqiu was confused and confused. She held the hairpin in her hand tightly and asked in a trembling voice, "Who are you? Where is this? How could I...how could I be here?"
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
The inn... the woman who bought it?
These words made Guan Lanqiu's frightened face turn even paler, and she shook her head hastily, "No! I didn't sell myself. There must be a misunderstanding. I can't stay here..."
She wanted to get up, but found that her body was weak and weak, and a numbness rose rapidly from her stomach, making her whole body feel hot.
"What are you talking about!" The man stood in front of her and said displeasedly: "I paid a lot of money and finally got a beautiful woman. How can I get it if I don't try it? You can't leave!"
